episodes.190126: A cutoff upper-level low was situated over the Lower Colorado River Valley area on the 18th, bringing some unsettled weather to parts of south-central Arizona. SBCAPE in excess of 500 J/kg along with steep mid-level lapse rates led to thunderstorms producing hail around 0.75. No damage was reported with these thunderstorms.
episodes.190422: A thunderstorm moving offshore produced a strong wind gust in the Banana River.

events.county: Volusia-Brevard County Line To Sebastian Inlet 0-20Nm
events.narrative: The WeatherFlow site XCCB in the Banana River measured a 36 knot wind gust from the northwest.
